```{r}
docs <- readRDS(here::here("data", "documents.rds"))

pdf_folder <- "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/3ymtsdj56ql27esobmwrz/AD4CNJLKn-fL3__f7qwQ2j8?rlkey=50k5ronmzaoi8l0ek2czwenyw&dl=0"
pdf_zip    <- "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/f5rv65r5hu2w7sa2ajxfb/doctrines.zip?rlkey=2gptax96y9q2me443a7lalapv&dl=0"
text_csv   <- "https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/e3cv6oo7gjlb3lg9mfwnu/01b_nss-doctrine-text.csv?rlkey=wh2qvebmodaq5nlr8u9jrte3g&dl=1"

zip_mb <- function(f) sprintf("%.0f MB", file.size(here::here("content", "data_copy", f)) / 1e6)
```

## Bulk downloads

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Metadata (.csv)](data_copy/nss_metadata.csv) | One row per document: country, year, title, language, type, core-corpus flag. See the [codebook](codebook.qmd). |
| [All full texts (.zip, `r zip_mb("nss_txt_all.zip")`)](data_copy/nss_txt_all.zip) | One `.txt` file per document, plus the metadata. |
| [All chunked texts (.zip, `r zip_mb("nss_chunks_all.zip")`)](data_copy/nss_chunks_all.zip) | One `_chunks.csv` file per document, plus the metadata. |
| [All texts in one table (.csv, ~190 MB)](`r text_csv`) | Page-level text for every document in a single file. |
| [All PDFs (.zip, ~10 GB)](`r pdf_zip`) · [PDF folder](`r pdf_folder`) | The original documents as published. |

## Browse documents

Search across all columns, or filter a column using the box under its header. `r nrow(docs)` documents in total. The **PDF** link opens the original document; **TXT** opens the extracted text; **CSV** downloads the chunked text.

**Download your results.** The buttons below download whatever the table currently shows: type *United States* in the search box, for example, and *Texts (.zip)* returns every US document's text. The metadata file includes a `pdf_url` column with a direct link to each document's PDF.

```{=html}
<div class="results-download">
  <span>Download results:</span>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="downloadResultsCSV()">Metadata (.csv)</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="downloadResultsZip('txt_url', 'texts')">Texts (.zip)</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="downloadResultsZip('csv_url', 'chunks')">Chunked texts (.zip)</button>
  <span id="results-status" class="results-status" aria-live="polite"></span>
</div>
```

```{r}
link <- function(url, label, download = FALSE) {
  ifelse(is.na(url), "",
         sprintf('<a href="%s"%s%s>%s</a>', url,
                 if (download) " download" else "",
                 if (label == "PDF") ' target="_blank" rel="noopener"' else "",
                 label))
}

tbl <- docs |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Country = country,
    Year = year,
    Title = title,
    Language = dplyr::if_else(language == "eng", "English", "Non-English"),
    Type = dplyr::case_when(type == "cyber" ~ "Cyber",
                            type == "terrorism" ~ "Terrorism",
                            TRUE ~ "General"),
    `Core corpus` = dplyr::if_else(keep == 1L, "Yes", "No"),
    Files = paste(link(pdf_url, "PDF"), link(txt_url, "TXT"),
                  link(csv_url, "CSV", download = TRUE), sep = " "),
    # Hidden columns used by the download-results buttons
    file_names, country_name, year, title, language, keep, type,
    pdf_url, txt_url, csv_url
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Country, Year, Title)

hidden <- reactable::colDef(show = FALSE)

reactable::reactable(
  tbl,
  elementId = "docs-table",
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  striped = TRUE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  compact = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 25,
  showPageSizeOptions = TRUE,
  pageSizeOptions = c(25, 50, 100, 1000),
  columns = list(
    Country = reactable::colDef(minWidth = 130),
    Year = reactable::colDef(width = 75),
    Title = reactable::colDef(minWidth = 260),
    Language = reactable::colDef(width = 110),
    Type = reactable::colDef(width = 95),
    `Core corpus` = reactable::colDef(width = 105),
    Files = reactable::colDef(html = TRUE, filterable = FALSE, sortable = FALSE,
                              width = 130),
    file_names = hidden, country_name = hidden, year = hidden, title = hidden,
    language = hidden, keep = hidden, type = hidden,
    pdf_url = hidden, txt_url = hidden, csv_url = hidden
  ),
  theme = reactable::reactableTheme(
    color = "var(--bs-body-color)",
    backgroundColor = "transparent",
    borderColor = "var(--bs-border-color)",
    stripedColor = "var(--bs-tertiary-bg)",
    highlightColor = "var(--bs-secondary-bg)",
    inputStyle = list(backgroundColor = "var(--bs-body-bg)",
                      color = "var(--bs-body-color)",
                      borderColor = "var(--bs-border-color)"),
    pageButtonStyle = list(color = "var(--bs-body-color)"),
    selectStyle = list(backgroundColor = "var(--bs-body-bg)",
                       color = "var(--bs-body-color)")
  )
)
```

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js"></script>
<script>
const META_COLS = ["file_names", "country_name", "year", "title", "language",
                   "keep", "type", "pdf_url"];

function resultRows() {
  return Reactable.getState("docs-table").sortedData;
}

function setStatus(msg) {
  document.getElementById("results-status").textContent = msg;
}

function saveBlob(blob, filename) {
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  setTimeout(() => { URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 1000);
}

function downloadResultsCSV() {
  const esc = v => {
    if (v === null || v === undefined) return "";
    const s = String(v);
    return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;
  };
  const rows = resultRows();
  const lines = [META_COLS.join(",")].concat(
    rows.map(r => META_COLS.map(c => esc(r[c])).join(",")));
  saveBlob(new Blob([lines.join("\n") + "\n"], {type: "text/csv"}),
           "military_doctrines_metadata.csv");
  setStatus(rows.length + " documents.");
}

async function downloadResultsZip(col, label) {
  const rows = resultRows().filter(r => r[col]);
  if (!rows.length) { setStatus("No files in the current results."); return; }
  if (rows.length > 300 &&
      !confirm(rows.length + " files selected. The full-corpus zips under Bulk downloads are faster for large selections. Continue?")) return;
  const zip = new JSZip();
  let done = 0, failed = 0;
  const queue = rows.slice();
  const worker = async () => {
    while (queue.length) {
      const r = queue.shift();
      try {
        const res = await fetch(r[col]);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.status);
        zip.file(decodeURIComponent(r[col].split("/").pop()), await res.blob());
      } catch (e) { failed++; }
      setStatus("Fetching " + (++done) + " of " + rows.length + "…");
    }
  };
  await Promise.all(Array.from({length: 6}, worker));
  const meta = [META_COLS.join(",")].concat(rows.map(r => META_COLS.map(c => {
    const s = r[c] === null || r[c] === undefined ? "" : String(r[c]);
    return /[",\n]/.test(s) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;
  }).join(",")));
  zip.file("metadata.csv", meta.join("\n") + "\n");
  setStatus("Building zip…");
  const blob = await zip.generateAsync({type: "blob"});
  saveBlob(blob, "military_doctrines_" + label + ".zip");
  setStatus((rows.length - failed) + " files downloaded" +
            (failed ? "; " + failed + " could not be fetched." : "."));
}
</script>

<style>
.results-download { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin: .5rem 0 1rem; }
.results-status { color: var(--bs-secondary-color); font-size: .9em; }
</style>
```
